description: Scroll in a direction, or toward the top/bottom edge of scrollable content. Set until to a selector to reach an off-screen target in one command rather than a scroll-and-check loop. The optional amount is the finger-path fraction of the viewport axis, honored up to 0.8 of it; directional scrolls reduce release momentum, while app scroll physics determine the final content offset. A visible keyboard shortens the swiped band instead of being dismissed; when too little is left, the command refuses with scroll_keyboard_occludes_surface. A directional scroll also reports the movement it observed as movement: moved, at-edge, unchanged, or unobserved when the two reads could not back a claim either way; an unchanged surface inside a container that still hides content in that direction refuses with scroll_no_progress rather than repeating the requested distance. The movement field is absent where a tier verifies per pass (top/bottom, until), where the runtime cannot read a screen, or where a settle observation or a replay already owns that observation. Times out after 90s; a caller-supplied budget extends it.

androidDeviceAllowlist.description: Android serial allowlist used for device resolution.

device.description: Device name selector (a UDID belongs in udid, a serial in serial).

deviceTarget.description: Device target form. Maps to the CLI --target flag.

durationMs.description: Scroll duration in milliseconds when the backend supports pacing.

includeCost.description: Include per-command agent-cost (cost.wallClockMs, …) in structuredContent. Defaults to off; the default response shape is unchanged.

mcpOutputFormat.description: MCP text content format. Defaults to optimized agent-friendly text; use json for JSON text. Structured content is always returned separately.

platform.description: Platform selector used to resolve a device.

responseLevel.description: Response verbosity: token-cheap digest / default (today) / full. Defaults to default; the default response shape is unchanged.

serial.description: Android, HarmonyOS, or Vega VVD serial selector.

settle.description: After the action, wait for the UI to go quiet and return the settled diff vs the pre-action tree in the same response. Best-effort; never fails the action.

target.description: Alias for deviceTarget on commands without a UI target field. Interaction commands reserve target for the UI element.

udid.description: Apple device or simulator UDID; the selector that pins one device when several share a name.

until.description: Repeat scroll passes until this selector is visible on screen, then stop. Not valid with the top/bottom edge directions, which carry their own stop condition.

name: scroll

keyboardAvoided.description: Present only when an on-screen keyboard forced the swipe into the band above it; the reported pixels were planned against the shorter referenceHeight.

keyboardMinY.description: Where the keyboard began, in the same unit as the gesture coordinates. Clipped scrolls only.

movement.description: Directional scrolls only: what the owner observed after its gesture. `moved` means the content inside the scroller the swipe ran in differs from the tree the session stored immediately before the gesture; `at-edge` and `unchanged` mean it did not change, with no hidden content left to reveal and with no end-of-content signal to read, respectively; `unobserved` means the pair could not back a claim in either direction — nothing comparable was available (no stored tree, a capture from another lineage, a surface that never came to rest), or every difference sits outside the scroller that was swiped, which a changing status bar does on Android — so the reported distance rests on the gesture plan alone. The field is absent — which is never a claim that nothing moved — on the tiers that verify per pass (`scroll top`/`bottom`, `--until`), on a runtime bound without a capture, on a platform whose scroll dispatches no swipe (the Linux wheel), and where the caller already owns that observation (`--settle`, or a replay with `postGestureStabilization: false`).

passes.description: Edge and until scrolls only: how many scroll-and-check passes ran.

diff.description: Settled diff vs the pre-action tree (changed lines only).

ref.description: Plain ref body (e12) for added lines.

truncated.description: Lines were capped to the response bound.

ref.description: Plain ref body (e12) minted from the stored settled tree.

refsGeneration.description: Snapshot generation of the stored settled tree; refs on added diff lines were minted from it.

settled.description: Whether the UI held the quiet window before the deadline. false is advisory, not failure.

surfaceChange.description: Present when an in-place system surface (web sign-in or Apple Pay sheet) was presented over the app, or left it.

disclosure.description: Agent-facing sentence explaining the surface transition.

from.description: Surface the pre-action baseline described: a host bundle id, or app.

to.description: Surface the post-action capture describes: a host bundle id, or app.

tail.description: Unchanged interactive refs tail: still-present, actionable elements from the settled tree, attached only when diff carries zero added-line refs (a modal-dismiss/toast-only diff).

ref.description: Plain ref body (e12) minted from the stored settled tree.

tailTruncated.description: Present (true) when tail candidates exceeded the response cap.

until.description: Until scrolls only: the selector the passes stopped on.
